waypoints.name: Barclay Lake Trailhead
waypoints.directions: From US-2 at Baring, near milepost 41, turn north onto 635th Place NE across from the convenience store and cross the railroad tracks. After 0.3 mile keep left on 635th Place NE; it becomes FR 6024, which you follow about 3.9 potholed miles to its end at the Barclay Lake Trailhead at about 2,300 ft. A Northwest Forest Pass is required to park.

waypoints.name: Wing Peak Summit
waypoints.directions: Follow Barclay Creek Trail 1055, then bushwhack along Barclay Creek and up Tailgunner Creek to an old, overgrown logging road. A bootpath climbs forest to about 4,000 ft, crosses a Class 2-3 waterfall ravine, and follows the grass and snow of Tailgunner Couloir to Tailgunner Pass. From the pass, climb the northwest ridge's steep snow faces and rock benches to an exposed snowfinger below the summit horn, then a short rock step to the top.
